props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: armedChildren
props.description: Label swapped in while armed; the resting label is kept when omitted.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Disables the element and stamps `data-pending`, blocking activation entirely. Effective disabled is `disabled || isPending`.

props.name: isVisuallyDisabled
props.description: Renders the disabled treatment (`opacity-70`) and suppresses focus-on-press while the button stays fully interactive — click, keyboard and focus-visible all still work. For "looks disabled but explains itself on activation" flows.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called on the second press only, after the button disarms.

props.name: onIntent
props.description: Predictive-prefetch callback. Fires once when the pointer's predicted trajectory lands inside the inflated hit rect; browsers without the prediction API fail soft.

props.name: predictionZoneSize
props.description: Pixels the hit rect is inflated on every side when predicting pointer intent.

props.description: Recipe size axis. The `icon*` sizes are square and additionally require an `aria-label`.
